description: The plot illustrates how two metrics—perplexity and GPU memory ratio—vary as a function of “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, with both metrics shown simultaneously using two y-axes. The x-axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 100 with labeled ticks at 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100. The left y-axis is labeled “Perplexity”, uses a linear scale, and ranges approximately from 4.2 to 4.7 with ticks at 0.1 increments (4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5, 4.6, 4.7). The right y-axis is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from about 40% to 90% with labeled ticks at 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90. An orange solid line with circular markers labeled “Perplexity” starts near 4.6 at 0%, decreases to around 4.35 by roughly 40%, then fluctuates slightly around 4.38–4.42 through about 70%, and rises to about 4.5 by 100%; a red dashed horizontal reference line labeled “Full Cache PPL” sits near 4.4 across the full x-range. A blue solid line with circular markers labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio” increases gradually from roughly 40% at 0% to about 50% around 70%, then rises sharply to near 90% around 80% and remains near that level through 100%; a blue dash-dot horizontal reference line labeled “Full Cache GPU Mem.” lies near 90% across the full x-range.
